problem.title: Determine Whether Two Binary Search Trees are Structurally Identical
problem.problemStatement: Given the roots of two Binary Search Trees, determine whether both trees have identical structures and corresponding key values.
problem.input: • The first line contains N₁. • The next N₁ lines describe the first BST. • The following line contains N₂. • The next N₂ lines describe the second BST.
problem.output: • Print YES if the trees are identical; otherwise print NO.
